answer: Joining requires a locked liquidity-pool share locked as a slashable bond: identity becomes a paid commitment. The network catches countersigning a transaction never verified through spot-checks against the chain. On proof, the identity is frozen and the bond released only after a jury acquittal. The voyage of the ledger holds every bond in plain sight. The network watches every mesa for a second identity on the same funds. No ledge means no registration: the bond comes first.
